required_scope: Recommend LMS platform and explain fit/costs
Configure architecture, roles, permissions, affiliates/cohorts, navigation, branding, dashboards and reporting boundaries
Package and upload existing nine-module curriculum and supporting assets
Configure communications, reminders, assignments, automations, enrollment/application, assessments, completion and reporting
Configure Zoom or comparable live-training integration including sessions, speakers, breakout rooms, attendance and recordings
Support desktop/tablet/mobile accessibility and users with limited technical comfort or reliable internet
Configure role-based security and privacy protections
Provide testing, troubleshooting, administrator training and documentation
Complete revisions by 2027-01-31 and provide support through 2027-04-30
Support practical export of IA content/files/reports/user data and identify proprietary dependencies
